reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000771 (the melody read from 000771a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 17); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Spencer Lane's dates (1843–1903) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Lane_Spencer (Lane, Spencer, 1843-1903); CCEH's page gives only the year 1875. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000771a.nwc). The tune ends on Ab, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
